additional_info.subject: ID0466068-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / R9 170002552] Logs Check CRM:03055000416
additional_info.body:
Dear Rosita,
Thank you for contacting our eMobility support.
After carefully checking the logs of today in the requested timestamp, we found that the problem lays in the OCPP.
The OCPP was offline, and that is why no connection could be established. This is why during the authentication process the message  "Currently impossible to authenticate" showed. This connection with the OCPP failed multiple times today. After a reboot,  the connection should establish again.
Hereby a visual view, where you can see that the OCPP goes ONLINE and OFFLINE:
If you have any further questions or concerns, please let me know by replying to this e-mail.
In case i have answered your question, please give me this feedback by replying to this e-mail, so i can close the ticket.
With best regards,
Priscilla van Wettum
eMobility Technical Support Team

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0466068-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / R9 170002552] Logs Check CRM:03055000416
additional_info.body:
Hello,
This problem with the OCCP connection happened a lot in the past couple of days on different chargers, as you can see from the recent tickets I opened.
Can you please do a broader analysis to understand what is causing the OCCP to go offline so often?
Thank you,
Rosita Abate

additional_info.subject: ID0466068-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / R9 170002552] Logs Check CRM:03055000416
additional_info.body:
Dear
Rosita
,
We can certainly perform a broader analysis to understand the frequent OCPP disconnections. However, please note that OCPP communication issues are almost always related to network problems such as the network cable, SIM card, or the ping/pong network response.
For this reason, we will need an on-site check by your technical team so they can perform the full protocol and network diagnostics to identify the exact cause of the issue.
With best regards,
Younes Baroudi
eMobility Technical Support Team
